description:
INSPECTION: List all Terraform deployment runs for a session
Returns job IDs, statuses, types (apply/destroy), and timestamps for every run.
Use this to see deployment history, find job IDs for log inspection, or check which deployments succeeded or failed.

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing. Returns the deployment-job history (apply / destroy / plan / drift) for this session.

name: tfruns

count.description: Number of runs the backend reported.

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

cloud.description: Cloud provider the job ran against.

job_id.description: Job ID. Pass it to tfstatus, tflogs or tfoutputs.

job_type.description: Job type: apply, destroy, plan or drift.

updated_at.description: Time of the job's last status change (RFC 3339).

version_id.description: ID of the stack version the job ran.

session_id.description: Session ID these runs belong to.

title: List Deploy Runs
